text:
Born from me, from my shadow,
+
+it dawns across my skin,
+
+daybreak of drowsy light.
+
+
+A wild dove is your name,
+
+timid upon my shoulder.

translation.title: Born from Me, from My Shadow…
translation.editorial_note: The unnamed presence is allowed to shift between dawn, body, and name; brava becomes wild while its dove remains tenderly timid.
